summary: Apple Watch only: an indoor run's corrected treadmill distance now reaches Apple Health. The watch holds the HealthKit workout in a paused session while the treadmill question is up, then writes the final distance and finishes it, with recovery after a relaunch and retries for refused writes. Before, Health kept the motion estimate. No change to what either platform offers; the treadmill correction already existed on both watches.

Blood glucose (CGM) readings: the mobile sync now uploads individual glucose readings from Apple Health / Health Connect (with the all-day heart rate phase) to new blood glucose samples on the server. Web Reports > Measurements gets a Blood glucose card: one zoomable day of readings by source with context layers (food/carbs, exercise, sleep, medications, stress, caffeine, alcohol, hydration) and an events list. Mobile Measurements report gets a Measurement timeline card with the same day view for CGM glucose and also for any numeric custom measurement category. A saved glucose unit (mg/dL or mmol/L) is set in web Preferences and mobile App Settings.

affected_rows.change: Mobile now charts custom measurement categories in a report, in part: the Measurements report's timeline card offers every non-text custom category in its Measurement picker and draws one day of its readings with zoom, source and context layers (SparkyFitnessMobile/src/screens/MeasurementsReportScreen.tsx:344-349; src/components/reports/MeasurementTimelineCard.tsx:108-148; src/hooks/useMeasurementTimeline.ts:17-60). Web still has the per-category charts over the period with notes (CustomCategoryReport); mobile has a one-day view only. Same on iOS and Android.

Sync now also uploads individual blood glucose readings (CGM) on both platforms, after the main upload (SparkyFitnessMobile/src/services/shared/heartRateSamplesSync.ts:104-150 glucoseReadingsFromRecords, 417 device 'Apple Health'/'Health Connect', 522 syncAllDayGlucose; src/services/shared/healthSyncEngine.ts:594-615).

summary: Server: a sleep sync that omits a measurement (e.g. HRV) keeps the stored value; only an explicit null clears it. Data-correctness fix, no feature change.
Server: readiness endpoint used by the Docker health check (database, auth schema, restore guard). Deployment only, no app feature.

Sleep science (server) and the web Sleep report now read one row per day: a day's naps count toward sleep debt with its night instead of being treated as a separate night, and bed/wake times come from the main sleep in its own time zone (table, CSV, consistency chart). Correctness fix on web-only features; no parity change.

Server: a nap synced with the same wake date and source as the night is now stored as its own sleep entry instead of being merged into the night (unique index dropped, per-session upsert; Withings too). Naps from sync therefore show separately on web and in the mobile Naps card. Correctness fix; no parity change.

A night recorded by two sources counts once: server sleep analytics, sleep science, coach, compare and cycle queries and the web Sleep report and cycle daily log take one sleep per night (shared sleepSameNight rule). On Android, Health Connect sync now uploads only the most detailed session when two apps wrote the same night; iOS does not do this.

affected_rows.change: New iOS/Android difference: Android uploads one sleep session per night, keeping the more detailed one when two apps wrote the same night (SparkyFitnessMobile/src/services/healthconnect/provider.ts:104-107; src/services/healthconnect/index.ts:1745-1800 keepMostDetailedSleepSessions); iOS has no such step (SparkyFitnessMobile/AGENTS.md:155 'iOS does not do this yet').
